description: Defines the FeignException class, a custom runtime exception for handling HTTP errors in the Fineract client, including methods for accessing response details and messages.

classes.name: FeignException
classes.description: A custom exception class for Feign client errors, encapsulating HTTP status, request, response body, and messages.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with the exception.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Returns the original HTTP request that caused the exception.

methods.name: responseBody
methods.description: Returns the response body as a byte array.

methods.name: responseBodyAsString
methods.description: Converts the response body byte array to a String using the default charset.

methods.name: getDeveloperMessage
methods.description: Returns the developer message associated with the exception.

methods.name: getUserMessage
methods.description: Returns the user-facing message associated with the exception.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Overrides the default getMessage to include status, user message, developer message, and the super message.
